'''Adapted Summoners''' are a type of [[Mobs]], placed into the [[Adapted Parasites|Adapted]] Tier.

== ''Spawning'' ==
* Spawns after a [[Primitive Summoner]] accumulates a killcount of 30 and [[Evolution System|evolves]].
* Spawns in groups of 2 to 3, if [[Ubiquitous Development]] is Level 3 or higher, with a spawnweight of 15.
* Spawns inside the [[Parasite Biome]], with a spawnweight of 10.

== ''Behavior'' ==
Adapted Summoners are Melee Combatants.

* Adapted Summoners' Melee Attack is performed through contact damage.
*If the [[Generations|Generation]] is 4 or higher, Adapted Summoners can perform the following abilities:
**Summon certain parasites through the usage of [[Biomass]]. Summoned mobs will spawn with the [[Rage]] Effect. [[Adapted Summoner#Summoning|More info below]].
**Revive parasites if the fallen parasite's large Remain piece is present. Parasites revived by an Adapted Summoner will have 50% more health.
**Vomit on prey, which spawns a lingering cloud of [[Vomit]], [[Viral]], [[Corrosion]], Weakness, and Hunger.
**Like other Adapted land Parasites, vomit [[Residue]] in a 5x5 area every so often.
* Adapted Summoners can perform small leaps, both on land and in liquids.
* Adapted Summoners can sink in liquids to pursue submerged targets.
* Adapted Summoners will keep their distance from their enemies.
* Adapted Summoners can break blocks that have their [[Hardness]] Value up to 3, with a 40 ticks cooldown and 1 Blocks range.
{{Variants|count=3|Berserker=BerserkerAdaSummoner.png|Virulent=VirulentAdaSummoner.png|Breacher=BreacherAdaSummoner.png}}

=== ''Summoning'' ===
Adapted Summoners are capable of spawning various [[Mobs]], through the use of [[Biomass]].

The summoning Ability is based on Points, each Mob has a certain Points value.

'''Adapted Summoners have a total of 3 Points per summon and can summon 1 mob before its cooldown of 8 seconds with a cap of 6 parasites active at once.'''

=== ''Weaknesses'' ===
* Adapted Summoners, like any other [[Mobs|Mob]], present a weakness to Fire. Damage inflicted by Fire is quadrupled.
* Adapted Summoners' Tendrils, found on the sides of their body, can reset their [[Adaptation System|adaptation]], while also giving them the [[Bleeding]] and [[Rage]] Effects.

=== ''Post Death'' ===
* On death, Adapted Summoners have a chance to explode, releasing [[Remains|Adapted Remains]] and an effect cloud of stacking Poison and [[Call Of The Hive|COTH]].
** If at least one [[Colony]] exists in the dimension, Adapted Summoners will become [[Primitive Summoner|Primitive Summoners]] upon death instead.

== ''Trivia'' ==
* Adapted Summoners are also known as '''Canra''' in the Mod Files.
* Adapted Summoner's Model was considered by Dhanantry as the hardest to realize (it has been updated numerous times, throughout 1.9.0).
